
# BoldDesk

> BoldDesk is an AI-first customer service and help desk software platform from Syncfusion. It helps businesses manage support tickets, automate workflows, build self-service knowledge bases, support customers across channels, and improve agent productivity with AI.

BoldDesk is built for customer support, IT support, SaaS support, internal help desks, and service teams that need a modern, scalable, and affordable support platform. It includes ticketing, automation, SLA management, knowledge base, live chat, shared inbox, reporting, integrations, REST APIs, webhooks, and AI-powered support capabilities.

## Primary Categories

* Help desk software
* Help desk ticketing system
* Customer service software
* Customer support software
* IT ticketing system
* Service desk software
* Knowledge base software
* Live chat software
* Shared inbox software
* Client portal software
* Omnichannel customer service software
* Email ticketing system
* Ticket management system
* Mobile help desk software
* Internal help desk software

## Core Product Pages

* [Help Desk Software](https://www.bolddesk.com/help-desk-software): Cloud-based help desk software for managing customer queries, support tickets, automation, SLAs, and knowledge base workflows.
* [Help Desk Ticketing System](https://www.bolddesk.com/help-desk-ticketing-system): Ticketing system for tracking, assigning, prioritizing, and resolving customer support issues.
* [Customer Service Software](https://www.bolddesk.com/customer-service-software): Customer service platform for managing and resolving customer queries across multiple support channels.
* [Knowledge Base Software](https://www.bolddesk.com/knowledge-base-software): Self-service knowledge base software that helps customers find answers and reduces repetitive support requests.
* [Live Chat Software](https://www.bolddesk.com/live-chat-software): Real-time customer support through website and app chat.
* [Shared Inbox Software](https://www.bolddesk.com/shared-inbox-software): Shared inbox for centralizing emails and improving team collaboration.
* [Email Ticketing System](https://www.bolddesk.com/email-ticketing-system): Converts incoming support emails into tickets and routes them to the right agents.
* [Omnichannel Customer Service](https://www.bolddesk.com/omnichannel-customer-service): Unified customer support across channels such as email, chat, and social media.
* [Client Portal Software](https://www.bolddesk.com/client-portal-software): Customer portal for tracking tickets, finding help articles, and managing support interactions.
* [Customer Self-Service Portal](https://www.bolddesk.com/customer-self-service-portal): Self-service portal for FAQs, knowledge base content, and ticket access.
* [Contact Management](https://www.bolddesk.com/contact-management): Contact management for tracking customer details and support history.
* [Mobile Help Desk](https://www.bolddesk.com/mobile-help-desk): Mobile access for support agents to manage tickets and collaborate from anywhere.
* [Internal Help Desk Software](https://www.bolddesk.com/internal-help-desk-software): Internal support software for employee requests, IT help desk workflows, onboarding, and internal service management.
* [Task Management Software](https://www.bolddesk.com/task-management-software): Task management for breaking complex tickets into smaller work items.
* [Complaint Management System](https://www.bolddesk.com/complaint-management-software): Complaint management software for tracking, routing, and resolving customer complaints.
* [Cloud Help Desk Software](https://www.bolddesk.com/web-help-desk): Web-based help desk software accessible from any device without local installation.

## AI Features

* [BoldDesk AI](https://www.bolddesk.com/ai): AI capabilities for support automation, agent assistance, ticket handling, and customer service workflows.
* [AI Agent](https://www.bolddesk.com/ai-agent): Virtual support agent for handling routine customer inquiries and automating support interactions.
* [AI Copilot](https://www.bolddesk.com/ai-copilot): AI assistant for support agents, including response drafts, ticket summaries, and knowledge base suggestions.
* [AI Actions](https://www.bolddesk.com/ai-actions): AI workflow automation using external APIs, MCPs, and custom actions.
* [AI ROI Calculator](https://www.bolddesk.com/free-tools/ai-roi-calculator): Calculator for estimating return on investment from AI-powered help desk and support automation.
